# Mixed ordinary Boolean first-source observations

Copyright 2026 Masahiko G. Yamada. SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0.

Twelve complete small projects and their context/independent expectations were
frozen before observation. `first-files.json` binds28 original files: seven
desired forms, one existing finite T control and four capability counterexamples,
each with a schema-2 edition-2026 manifest. No original source was repaired.

The existing ordinary-Boolean CLI is identified by `identity-before.json` and
its prior `cli-build.json`: SHA
`522c0c188efd71e7d0d834a367a3789d9d04bad6f15c10a9931fd3259339d77f`.
It was reused without rebuilding or copying it. Its recorded source identities
matched the af26fad baseline. Native kernel SHA
`39effde0f152a2c926fcea3a7f99fc2f25f9de65906be2b8c527508353c90c85`
is bound independently. Production changes after this packet do not change what
that executable observed.

All35 actual calls are retained:12 finite checks (8pass/4reject),12 sized checks
(2pass/10reject),11 closed finite probes (8pass/3reject). The two sized successes
are the existing hierarchy checks of phase[1,3] and phase[1,4] on open Q<Bit>;
they are not execution of the new mixed Raw adapter. In particular, fine phase
remains a negative for that selected finite target despite existing hierarchy
acceptance. The finite phase-name and Nat-profile failures, sized T alias
rejection and other downstream profile failures remain unchanged in the logs.

`closed-probe-comparison.json` compares the eight successful finite probes to
independent constants, Bell correlation/anticorrelation and H-T-H phase
probabilities with absolute tolerance1e-12. The saved expectations preceded
the runs. Those distributions alone do not establish eager evaluation or
retention of an ignored measurement; the new Rust integration tests separately
inspect source steps and actual native-accepted operations.

The helper/call/fold tests use at most two qubits. Native validity, source-step
correspondence, algorithm meaning and full source preservation remain distinct.
This is an informed study under the existing plan, not a model benchmark, new
adoption, completed Issue, formal theorem or release validation. No Cargo/Lean
build, full source snapshot or maximum-size case was run.
